units: Reference pixels at 1920x1080; durations in milliseconds.
dataScope: Twenty-eight local preview fragments and sample percentages, not online Race story or save data.

entry.reducedMotion: Selections and routes update immediately; fragment activation uses the reduced-motion page transition.
entry.initialCamera: Vertically centered on the selected fragment; horizontal origin retained.
entry.nodeActivation: Click or Enter starts the explored fragment directly; normal 150ms page exit, no confirmation modal.

edgeFade.type: Intersected horizontal and vertical alpha masks on the graph viewport.

selection: Only explored, unlocked nodes can be selected or replayed. Active paths must only contain playable nodes; retain the selected upstream branch at merges.
keyboard: Arrows select playable nodes; Home/End select the first/last playable fragment; PageUp/PageDown browse vertically, Shift pages horizontally; Enter starts the selected fragment directly.
unexplored: Native disabled button, aria-disabled, tabIndex -1, dim image and lock icon. No percentage or progress track. Cannot select or start; wrapper still supports dragging.
sound: Playable and locked hover share the exact ui-hover.wav recording, including its soft onset, harmonics and stereo tail. Locked playbackRate is .5 at level .44; normal node hover is rate 1 at level .48. Existing 110ms intent, 650ms throttle, drag suppression and master mute remain. No other audio or opening changes.

scrolling.positionStoredPerChapter: Reference-pixel offsets on both axes, restored on return and replay.
scrolling.initialView: Selected fragment is vertically centered; individual card size is preserved.

edgeFade.type: Intersected horizontal and vertical alpha masks on the graph viewport.

progress.display: Explored fragments only: compact 48px thin track and 12px percentage integrated at the right of the bottom information row.

dust.reducedMotion: Hide dust; keep the static selection glow.

layout: Graph ranks come from connections; alternating barycentric sweeps order related branches. Each layer is vertically centered, with no fixed row slots. The graph extent grows with branch count and depth.

modelChecks.includes: Graph connectivity, unlocked routes, two-axis reveal, no card overlap, eight-way fanout and repeated merges.

connectorRouting: Rounded elbows use separate source lanes to keep rich split and merge trunks distinct.
activation: Clicking a playable fragment selects its route and directly enters that fragment. No separate detail panel, start button or confirmation modal.
